picks.title: AI chipmaker Groq confirms $650M raise, re-staffs after Nvidia's $20B not-acqui-hire deal
picks.why_it_matters: Massive funding round signals continued investor appetite for AI infrastructure plays outside the Nvidia ecosystem, and the post-acqui-hire rebuild creates potential dealflow as displaced talent may spin out new ventures.

picks.title: Seedcamp raises $320M for its new fund to expand its US footprint
picks.why_it_matters: A major European seed fund expanding stateside increases competition for US early-stage deals and may bring more cross-Atlantic co-investment opportunities.

picks.title: WhatsApp gets new chief as Meta taps India's CRED founder Kunal Shah and invests $900M in startup
picks.why_it_matters: A proven fintech founder moving to Meta creates a leadership vacuum at CRED and signals Big Tech's growing interest in India's consumer fintech playbook—watch for CRED alumni starting new ventures.
